note: Jefferson County TN publishes zoning only as PDF (county zoning resolution and map; Jefferson City zoning map is a PDF with legend; Dandridge ordinance is PDF). No queryable zoning district polygon layer was found on the county's GIS consortium services (jcgiscb ArcGIS org: no zoning layer). The county parcel layer Parcels_CAMA_A has a ZONING field but it is blank for nearly all parcels (4 non-blank of 35,167), so it is not usable as zoning. Morristown's city zoning_districts service lies almost entirely in Hamblen County, outside this county.
